kind: two live trials, four decision trials with simulated observations

cases.request: /xlclean Convert Sales.xlsx and Forecast.xlsx in the work folder to values. Put the results in an `out` folder next to them.
cases.setup: Sales.xlsx has two formulas with cached values and manual calculation mode. Forecast.xlsx has one formula with no cached value. The executable is available.
cases.expect: Chooses `values`; one invocation; exit 1 treated as a partial batch; the converted output path read from the result; the warning passed on verbatim; missing-cached-value reported with an Excel recalculate-and-save; no invented values.

cases.request: /xlclean Excel says "Too many different cell formats" when I open Report.xlsm. Can you clean it up? Save the result in `cleaned`.
cases.setup: Report.xlsm has thousands of unused custom styles, duplicate cell formats, and a VBA project. The executable is available.
cases.expect: Chooses `styles`, not `values`; reads the output path and the before/after counts from `changes`; passes on the macro warning verbatim; does not claim number formats, fonts, or in-use styles were removed.

cases.request: /xlclean Paste values for Q3.xlsx on my Desktop.
cases.setup: Linux x64. `xlclean --version` returns command not found. `gh auth status` reports no login. The .NET SDK and git are installed. The user has said nothing about installing software.
cases.expect: Loads installation.md only; reports the missing executable; no source build or other converter; asks for authorization to install from the public release or for the release files.

cases.request: /xlclean Convert Budget.xlsx to values but keep the formulas in the header, rows 1 to 4. Leave the 'Assumptions' sheet alone.
cases.setup: The run of `xlclean values` with --start-row 5 --exclude Assumptions exits 1 with formula-range-crosses-boundary for an array formula at C3:C9.
cases.expect: Loads recovery.md only; does not retry the same boundary; explains that each alternative changes the requested scope and asks the user to choose.

cases.request: /xlclean I generated model.xlsx with openpyxl just now, it has about 200 formulas. Also there's an old legacy.xls. Recalculate both and give me values-only copies.
cases.setup: The executable works. Python with openpyxl and LibreOffice are available.
cases.expect: States the tool never calculates; anticipates missing-cached-value; reports .xls as unsupported; does not recalculate with another engine unasked, and names the engine and its possible difference from Excel if offering it.

cases.request: /xlclean Clean the styles in Legacy.xlsx and Data.xlsb.
cases.setup: The `xlclean styles` run exits 1: Legacy.xlsx failed with unsupported-workbook-content naming an Excel 4.0 macro sheet; Data.xlsb converted with 1200 to 9 cell styles.
cases.expect: Loads recovery.md only; reports Data.xlsb's output and counts; reports the macro sheet as a tool limit; does not delete the macro sheet or use another cleaner without asking.
